response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains but lacks direct experience with C++ on Windows platforms, SQL Server/Oracle, or capital markets/fixed income systems. Their primary expertise lies in Node.js, TypeScript, and Dlang, with no clear evidence of heavy C++ development or financial-domain exposure.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship with TDD, CI/CD, and dev-ops practices
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development experience on Windows (mandatory skill)
No domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
Limited experience with SQL Server/Oracle (mandatory skill)
